name: exclude-ranked-rows
questions: Which were our six best-selling products by units sold in Q4 2025?
Leave out the first two products from that ranking and show the remaining products with their units sold.

name: count-customer-subset
questions: Rank our top eight customers by number of distinct orders in 2025, using their customer IDs.
How many of those eight customers placed at least two orders? Give the count only.

name: monthly-threshold
questions: Show our revenue for each month in the first half of 2025.
Keep only the months where revenue was below 2500, with the revenue alongside each month.

name: category-order-value
questions: Show our six highest-revenue product categories in 2025.
For these categories, add revenue per order and sort the displayed categories by that value, highest first.

name: state-add-metric
questions: Which five states had the most distinct customers for our brand in 2025?
Add revenue for each of those states, keeping the same states and order.

name: brand-alphabetical
questions: Across all brands, show the top four brands by revenue in Q3 2025.
Display just those brand names and revenues, ordered alphabetically by brand name.

name: reverse-comparison
questions: Compare our total revenue in Q4 2025 against Q3 2025, including the absolute and percentage change.
Reverse the comparison: evaluate Q3 against Q4 as the baseline, with the absolute and percentage change.

name: status-override
questions: Show our top five products by revenue in Q1 2025 using only completed orders and completed items.
Rerun that ranking for the same quarter with all qualifying statuses, still excluding cancelled and returned orders and items.

name: preserve-product-filter
questions: Show revenue for product IDs 8252 and 23740 in Q2 2025.
Use the same product IDs for Q4 2025 instead.

name: change-inactivity-threshold
questions: Compare customer inactivity on January 1 and April 1, 2025, using a 90-day inactivity threshold.
Keep both snapshot dates but use 60 days of inactivity instead.

name: empty-result-count
questions: Show our top three products by revenue in January 1900.
How many products were returned in that result?

name: draft-then-save
questions: Draft a Q4 2025 sales report with total revenue, monthly revenue, top three products and proposed actions for Q1 2026. Do not save it.
Save that draft as "Winter review v2".

name: cancel-preview-and-list
questions: Prepare a deletion preview for my saved report titled "Winter review v2".
Cancel that deletion and then list my saved reports.

name: scope-recovery
questions: Show Levi's total revenue for Q2 2025.
Then show Calvin Klein total revenue for that same quarter instead.

name: forecast-to-actual
questions: Predict our revenue for Q1 2027.
Use actual revenue for Q1 2025 instead.
